messages:
erin-partners: Heads up: NovaWeights wants marketplace + SI rehosting rights, but they flagged geographic restrictions (no China hosting) and special HW bundle terms for an edge SI. Need to map requirements before we accept listing.

dave-ops: Ops checklist: canonical model card, export classification (ECCN), signed provenance chain for each build, hardware-compat matrix (A100, H100, T4, Jetson), and a sample on-prem package with sha256s. Also confirm whether provider permits our quantize-for-serving flow.

leah-legal: Their current license has a geo-restriction clause: "No commercial hosting or resale in Mainland China." For marketplace we must surface that as SKU metadata (region_allowlist). Reseller rights need explicit revocation triggers if they change license later. I'll prepare a geo-aware reseller addendum template.

ravi-eng: For HW bundles: they want to ship an optimized kernel for Jetson which uses proprietary compile flags. We need attestations that the bundle doesn't contain third-party binary blobs we can't ship. If it's proprietary, SI bundles will require a restricted distribution addendum and a signed SBOM.

sylvia-infra: Key custody: for on-prem SI we prefer the provider rotate a signing key into our onboarding HSM. If they refuse, require an offline PGP-signed manifest with verified key fingerprint. Also: for geoblocked SKUs we will enforce region routing in the control plane and include an infra flag blocked_regions:["CN"].

erin-partners: Business asked for revenue-share: provider asked 25% for hosted, 40% for SI/reseller. Propose our standard bands: hosted 15-25%, resell 25-35% depending on co-sell involvement. Need finance input on margins for Jetson-optimized bundle.

dave-ops: Also request that Nova provide a perf attestation doc: measured p50/p95 on declared hardware and the test harness used. Ops will replicate tests before soft-listing. If they supply Accelerated kernels, note licensing for those kernels in the SBOM.

leah-legal: Embargo/announce: we can do partner-only announce after reseller addendum signed and provenance validated. Public announce after SI soft-launch. I'll add termination on provenance mismatch + escrow clause for critical fixes.

ravi-eng: Streaming compatibility note: their tokenizer emits multi-byte markers that break our streaming chunker. We'll need a small shim in the SDK and an interim warning in the docs. Also need the tokenizer token-to-byte mapping.

sylvia-infra: For marketplace SKU naming: partner.<provider>.<model>.<hwopt> e.g., partner.novaweights.neo13b.jetson_opt. SKU metadata must include allowed_resellers, blocked_regions, quant_profiles, price_tiers.

erin-partners: Action list: 1) Leah draft geo-aware reseller addendum; 2) Dave request perf attestation + SBOM + build artifacts; 3) Ravi to prototype SDK shim; 4) Sylvia make manifest validator and region-gating checklist; 5) Finance to model rev-share margins. Check-in next Wed.

partnerbot: auto: created partner-onboard ticket PRT-5238 (owner: erin-partners).

erin-partners: Looping in ops@novaweights.ai for artifacts and confirmation of geo/release constraints. Thanks all.
